purpose: Formalise the KP-dominance analysis from ml/audit.py and ml/sequences.csv. Documents what the temporal window adds beyond the KP-only and last-known-state baselines, within the controlled simulation benchmark only.
data_source: ml/sequences.csv (12,000 sequences, frozen). No model retraining. No feature ablation performed.
scope: SIMULATION ONLY. Does not constitute evidence of real spacecraft forecasting capability.

feature_importance.interpretation: kp_index_t5 accounts for 83.3% of learned feature importance. The temporal window provides the remaining 16.7%, primarily through solar-wind density and rate-of-change signals.

shortcut_learning_check.description: Audit of whether the CRITICAL_AHEAD label can be derived directly from the last-step KP value alone (kp_index_t5 > 4.0). Applied to the full 12,000-sequence dataset.
shortcut_learning_check.interpretation: 84.7% of CRITICAL_AHEAD sequences already exhibit kp_t5 > 4.0 at the last window step, which is why KP-only achieves F1=0.8977. The remaining 15.3% (1,083 sequences) have kp_t5 <= 4.0 but escalate to CRITICAL_AHEAD — these are the cases that require temporal reasoning beyond the KP threshold shortcut.

rising_trend_analysis.description: Sequences where the t5-snapshot rule (applied to t5 features alone) predicts NOMINAL but the true future label is CRITICAL_AHEAD. These represent early-warning cases where temporal pattern is required.
rising_trend_analysis.method: t5-snapshot rule: CRITICAL if kp_t5>6 or orb_t5>1.5 or pwr_t5<10.0; or kp_t5>4 or orb_t5>0.8 or pwr_t5<40.0. Applied to the last window step only. This is the same rule as the last-known-state baseline.

rising_trend_characteristics.interpretation: Rising-trend sequences show KP at t0 ~2.7, rising to ~3.45 at t5 (delta ~+0.73) — still below the 4.0 threshold at the last step, but escalating to CRITICAL_AHEAD within 30 minutes. The positive delta_kp signal is the primary temporal indicator.

regime_breakdown.note: 94.9% of rising-trend cases belong to the nominal_rising regime (KP 1.0-3.5, rising toward warning zone), confirming this is the primary challenge scenario for the temporal model.

rising_trend_analysis.interpretation: 1,044 of 12,000 sequences (8.7%) represent cases where the current KP state alone does not indicate criticality, but the 30-minute outcome is CRITICAL_AHEAD. The temporal window captures the rising KP trend required to identify these cases.

temporal_value_statement.claim: The temporal model provides additional predictive value within the controlled simulation benchmark, beyond the KP-only and last-known-state baselines.
evidence: +7.3 percentage points macro-F1 vs KP-only (0.9708 vs 0.8977)
+14.4 percentage points CRITICAL recall vs KP-only (0.9819 vs 0.8382)
1,044 sequences (8.7%) where temporal reasoning is required and KP-only would miss
163 such cases in the 1,800-sequence test partition
rising_trend regime (nominal_rising) accounts for 94.9% of these cases
Non-KP features (solar wind density, rate-of-change signals) contribute 16.7% of total feature importance
honest_qualifications: KP remains the dominant feature at 83.3% importance — this is disclosed and unchanged.
The simulation label is derived from HelioMesh safety rules applied to simulated telemetry, NOT from real satellite failure records.
The 30-minute temporal benchmark is validated only on the HelioMesh simulation. It is NOT validated on real OPS-SAT spacecraft data.
The benchmark does not constitute a feature ablation study — no model was retrained with features removed.
The gains vs baselines are computed within the same simulation benchmark; they do not transfer automatically to other spacecraft or missions.

kp_only_threshold_scan.description: KP threshold scan over full 12,000-sequence dataset (from ml/audit.py). Provided for completeness only. Frozen model metrics come from ml/forecaster_metrics.json.
kp_only_threshold_scan.note: kp_t5 > 4.0 is the strongest single-feature shortcut. The frozen KP-only baseline in forecaster_metrics.json uses this threshold on the chronological test set.

critical_rate_by_kp_bin.description: CRITICAL_AHEAD rate by KP bin over full 12,000-sequence dataset (from ml/audit.py).
critical_rate_by_kp_bin.interpretation: The 3-4 KP bin (critical_rate=56.8%, 1,662 sequences) is the ambiguous zone where temporal reasoning is most valuable. KP alone is insufficient for reliable classification in this range.

limitations: This is NOT a feature ablation study. No model was retrained without KP.
All analysis is on simulation data only — not real spacecraft telemetry.
The temporal window adds value within this benchmark; external validity has not been established.
KP dominance (83.3%) is a genuine limitation of the current benchmark design.
The rising-trend count reflects simulation regime construction, not measured real-world incidence rates.
